initial.title: [Backlog][C-SDLC v2] Remove retired csdlc-migrate from installer and coexistence authority
initial.goal: Make the active installer and coexistence authority exactly match the claim-free v1-sunset C-SDLC v2 binary set.
initial.required_outcome: Current-main installation succeeds without csdlc-migrate, selector and provenance match the exact source revision, and an installed claim-free lifecycle canary passes; if current main already satisfies this, close with exact evidence and no speculative code.
authority_boundary: PR body must use Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5895
This is split issue/code publication authority, not repository cutover or issue migration
operator_constraints: Do not restore csdlc-migrate or any wrapper
Prefer no-code closure when current-main evidence already proves acceptance
initial.task_boundary: Verify and remove only active csdlc-migrate installer authority, then prove the installed claim-free route.
deliverables: Corrected active binary inventory if needed
Gate10A test that invokes a freshly installed generation for the claim-free lifecycle canary
Focused negative guard against csdlc-migrate reappearance
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: No authoritative installer, coexistence, selector, or current operator surface requires csdlc-migrate
AC-2: Clean current-main build and stable v2 installation succeed
AC-3: csdlc-install resolve selects v2 and installed provenance matches the exact source revision
AC-4: A focused negative guard rejects csdlc-migrate reappearance
AC-5: An installed claim-free create/validate/bind canary passes
AC-6: Historical evidence is unchanged and no compatibility route is added
dependencies: Execute before #5883 to avoid shared installer/coexistence conflicts
initial.plan_summary: Inventory current authority, make the smallest proven correction or evidence-only disposition, then prove install, resolve, provenance, retired-surface guard, and one installed lifecycle canary.

steps.action: Classify every current csdlc-migrate reference and determine whether active drift remains.
Delete only proven active stale expectations and add or tighten one focused negative guard, or record an already-resolved no-code disposition.
Build and install the declared current v2 set and verify selector plus exact provenance.
Run the installed claim-free create, validate, and bind canary and retain results.

invariants: No retired binary or compatibility shim
risks: Mistaking historical text for active authority
Passing with a stale installed generation
Adding code when the issue is already resolved
stop_conditions: Any need to restore or wrap csdlc-migrate
Installed provenance cannot be tied to exact source
The representative lifecycle canary does not use installed binaries

validation_lanes.proof_role: Run the complete focused Gate10A inventory/provenance suite, including a required test that installs the declared generation into an isolated stable layout and invokes its csdlc-issue, csdlc-validate, csdlc-doctor, and csdlc-bind binaries while proving csdlc-migrate is absent.
Prove claim-free create, validate, doctor, and bind semantics independently of the installed-generation provenance proof.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on active retired authority, install mismatch, stale selector/provenance, non-installed canary execution, or historical evidence churn.
review_prompts: Is every remaining csdlc-migrate reference non-authoritative or an explicit negative guard?
Does the proof use the installed current generation rather than Cargo output?
Was a no-code outcome chosen if the current tree already meets acceptance?
initial.review_scope: Installer/coexistence correctness, provenance, negative guard, and installed lifecycle canary only.
